waiting_times.weekdays: Moderate crowds. Trekking trails and darshanam lines are relatively quiet and peaceful.
waiting_times.weekends: High crowds, with wait times extending up to 1 to 2 hours at the main Lower and Upper temples.
waiting_times.swathi_nakshatram: Extreme crowds. The monthly star day witnesses massive queues at all nine temples for Abhishekam.
waiting_times.annual_brahmotsavam: Peak congestion. Hundreds of thousands of devotees occupy all guest rooms and local satrams.

tips: Seniors should limit visits to Lower Ahobilam, or use Doli services and trek during early morning hours.
